items.html: And all this MA and BON of Gadlut is called the "addition that departs," and only the BON of Katnut remains in both of them. This is so in ZON, but in AVI, the MA and BON always remain in them, since they already had, from the outset, the complete name BON at the time of the Melachim, in all ten Sefirot. Nevertheless, they too needed MA and BON in the manner mentioned above regarding ZON, so that the essence of MA is in the male and its illumination in the female, and the reverse in BON. And since Hochma and Bina come only from the Bina of MA, their root is judgments and not mercy, even though they are MA.
